newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil's CEMIG plans $150 mln, 8-year bond in Oct.
newsitem.headline: Brazil's CEMIG plans $150 mln, 8-year bond in Oct.

text.p: CEMIG, the state power firm in Brazil's Minas Gerais state, plans to set a $150 million eight-year Eurobond in mid-October via lead manager ING Barings, CEMIG's assistant finance director Luiz Fernando Rolla said.
The dollar-denominated bond will have a call option after five years and should offer a yield of about 10 percent, Rolla said.
"The money will be sufficient to finish our investment plan this year and part of next year," Rolla told Reuters in an interview.
The investment plan includes an expansion of power transmission lines to help prepare CEMIG for increasing competition in the power sector, some of which is slated for privatization.
Minas Gerais state government plans to retain 51 percent of CEMIG's voting capital, Rolla said.
